title: Ulyana and the Thorn
author: Beatrix Blackwood
blurb: Vesper Amberdale, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
